hypothesis: A different locally executed VLM can distinguish visible region departure, arrival and staying from ordered images; image absence must not produce an invented movement.
synthetic_gate: All six visual responses and two no-image conditions exact valid format with EOS, no technical/resource failure. Complete the eight fixed controls even on normal wrong answers; no retries or numeric-text prerequisite.

pilot.selection: Sorted SHA256 within label0 then label1, skip already used automatic groups; freeze selected sources privately before inference; interleave final selection by SHA256
pilot.sampling: Uniform normalized video positions 0.05..0.95, sequential PTS-aware decode, full field letterboxed; label point never selects frames
pilot.predicate: Visible departure of a person initially located at a workstation, with another person still near it; no identity, cashier role, service completion or legal conclusion
pilot.unknown: Separate UNKNOWN outcome and coverage; never silently convert to no_violation
pilot.continuation_gate: Technical completion6/6; unknown<=1; departure YES in at least2/3 positive-label videos and at most1/3 negative-label videos; max upload-excluded decode+inference time<=70s. Proxy association only, not action/type/legal accuracy or release.

privacy: Native Transformers trust_remote_code false, offline process guard, no audio/face ID/cloud inference. Raw model responses/logs never persisted. Only aggregate reports emitted; structured pilot rows remain private and unread by cloud tools.
limits: Different VLM weights/vision/training, but shared Qwen3 language-model family. Synthetic success does not validate people/roles/rules. TRAIN reused and automatic groups unreviewed; TUNE/HOLDOUT closed. No production model/threshold/registry change.
